I teach graduate courses in data science, statistics, and data science for public
policy at the School of Government and Public Transformation of Tecnológico de
Monterrey. Before that, I taught undergraduate programming, mathematics, statistics,
and machine learning at the Universidad Politécnica de Yucatán, where I also directed
the Data Engineering program.

## Mentoring

I advise master's theses and applied projects in data science, urban analytics, and
public policy, and I serve on thesis committees. If you are a student interested in
working on these topics, [get in touch](mailto:gonzalo.peraza@tec.mx) with a short note
about your interests.

{{< cv supervision >}}

## Resources

- [ISLR-Python-Labs](https://github.com/gperaza/ISLR-Python-Labs): Python versions of
  the labs in *An Introduction to Statistical Learning*.
- [ISL_labs_python](https://github.com/gperaza/ISL_labs_python): the labs of the
  book's second edition, translated to Python.
- [ap6001-data](https://github.com/CentroFuturoCiudades/ap6001-data): lightweight
  extracts of INEGI surveys (ENIGH, ENOE) for the notebooks of my probability and
  statistics course.
